description.value:
Your charmed shots twist around branches and leaves, leaving your hapless prey without shelter from your barrage. While in this stance, your ranged attacks ignore concealment and cover from natural sources, such as foliage or mist. In addition, if you have access to the bow's critical specialization effect, you apply it even if a creature you critically hit isn't adjacent to a surface or would otherwise be immune due to being incorporeal or liquid, your arrows splintering into vines that entangle the target.

If your hunting partner is in the emanation of your wild link aura while you're in this stance, they gain the same benefits, but they must have access to the bow's critical specialization effect to apply the effect to creatures they critically hit).
